prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1430; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Vehicle inspected at the body shop following a low-speed collision in a parking lot. The damage to the rear bumper cover, left quarter panel and tail lamp assembly is largely consistent with the impact described by the insured. Repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, refinishing the quarter panel, and installing a new tail lamp, with labor hours that fit the extent of the damage. Invoice lines reviewed show no duplicated charges. No prior damage to the vehicle has been identified in the records or during inspection. Parts pricing and paint materials are standard for this model year.
